title: D4Z4 methylation and genetic modifiers influence severity in a facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy kindred
title_zh: D4Z4甲基化与遗传修饰因子影响面肩肱型肌营养不良家系的病情严重程度
abstract: Abstract One of the earliest systematic descriptions of facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD) involved a six-generation kindred tracing back to a single ancestor born in 1775 in Lancashire, England, who later emigrated to Utah in the 1850s. First published in 1950, members of this kindred (K1462) have been followed clinically for decades, with DNA samples archived since the 1980s. Despite sharing the same 5-repeat unit (5RU) D4Z4 contraction on a permissive 4qA haplotype, affected individuals show marked variability in age at onset, clinical severity and disease progression, including within sibships. With long-term follow-up and a shared founder mutation, K1462 is a unique resource for identifying modifiers of disease expression in FSHD. We reintroduce K1462, with enrolment extending into the ninth generation, and perform genomic analysis using modern approaches. Inheritance of the 5RU founder allele was confirmed in 139 individuals, and nanopore Cas9-targeted sequencing determined CpG methylation across the contracted D4Z4 array at base-pair resolution. The 5RU allele showed complete penetrance; however, clinical severity and progression varied widely among affected individuals. Longitudinal analysis of blood-derived genomic DNA demonstrated high stability of D4Z4 CpG methylation within individuals, including samples collected up to 38 years apart, indicating long-term maintenance of the epigenetic state. In contrast, D4Z4 methylation levels differed substantially between individuals and showed a strong inverse correlation with clinical severity. Differences in D4Z4 methylation were observed both within and between families, with a modest but consistent parent-of-origin effect. Whole-genome sequencing analysis found no evidence that rare variants in known FSHD2 genes explained this variability. To assess the contribution of common genetic variation, we performed a pedigree-based genome-wide association analysis of D4Z4 methylation levels, identifying a single genome-wide significant locus on chromosome 15. Variants spanning the promoter and 5′ region of HDGFL3, which encodes a PWWP domain chromatin-interacting protein, were associated with increased D4Z4 methylation after accounting for parental transmission, supporting a role for common-variant modulation of methylation in FSHD. These results support a model in which D4Z4 methylation is established through transmission-associated epigenetic resetting, stably maintained within individuals, and quantitatively modified by inherited genetic variation. Together, these findings demonstrate that D4Z4 methylation is a stable, individual-level epigenetic feature that varies across a multigenerational pedigree in a manner that correlates with clinical severity, confirming D4Z4 methylation as a quantitative biomarker and genetically modifiable contributor to disease severity in FSHD.
abstract_zh: 摘要 面肩肱型肌营养不良（FSHD）最早的系统性描述之一涉及一个可追溯至单一祖先的六代家系，该祖先于1775年出生于英国兰开夏郡，后来在19世纪50年代移民至犹他州。该家系（K1462）的成员首次于1950年发表，临床随访已持续数十年，DNA样本自20世纪80年代起存档。尽管共享相同的5个重复单位（5RU）D4Z4收缩，且位于许容性4qA单倍型上，受累个体在发病年龄、临床严重程度和疾病进展方面存在显著差异，甚至包括同胞间的差异。凭借长期随访和共享的奠基者突变，K1462是识别FSHD疾病表达修饰因子的独特资源。我们重新引入K1462，入组涉及第九代，并采用现代方法进行基因组分析。在139名个体中确认了5RU奠基等位基因的遗传，纳氏Cas9靶向测序以碱基对分辨率测定了收缩D4Z4阵列中的CpG甲基化。5RU等位基因表现出完全渗透率；然而，受累个体之间的临床严重程度和进展差异巨大。对血液来源基因组DNA的纵向分析表明，个体内D4Z4 CpG甲基化高度稳定，包括相隔长达38年采集的样本，表明表观遗传状态的长期维持。相比之下，D4Z4甲基化水平在个体间差异显著，并与临床严重程度呈强烈负相关。D4Z4甲基化差异在家族内部和家族间均有观察到，并伴有一个温和但一致的亲本起源效应。全基因组测序分析未发现已知FSHD2基因中的罕见变异可以解释这种变异性。为评估常见遗传变异的贡献，我们对D4Z4甲基化水平进行了基于家系的全基因组关联分析，在15号染色体上确定了一个全基因组显著位点。跨越HDGFL3启动子和5′区域的变异与D4Z4甲基化增加相关（在调整亲本传播后），该基因编码一种含PWWP结构域的染色质相互作用蛋白，支持常见变异对甲基化调节在FSHD中的作用。这些结果支持一种模型，即D4Z4甲基化通过与传播相关的表观遗传重置建立，在个体内稳定维持，并由遗传变异进行定量修饰。这些发现共同表明，D4Z4甲基化是一种个体水平的稳定表观遗传特征，它在多代家系中变异，并与临床严重程度相关，证实了D4Z4甲基化作为定量生物标志物和可遗传修饰的FSHD疾病严重程度贡献因子的地位。
